newsitem.title: CAMEROON: SOCCER-CAMEROON NAME BELGIAN COACH FOR NATIONAL TEAM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CAMEROON NAME BELGIAN COACH FOR NATIONAL TEAM.

text.p: Cameroon have named a Belgian national as coach for the national soccer squad, the Indomitable Lions, whose performances have slumped since they grabbed the limelight in the 1990 World Cup.

Youth and Sports Minister Joseph Marie Bipoun said in a statement released late on Tuesday that Henri Depireux would have the job of preparing the national side for the 1998 African Nations and World Cup competitions.
The Indomitable Lions won many fans abroad for their thrilling performance at the 1990 World Cup finals when they reached the quarter-finals.
But they failed to get to the last 16 in the 1994 finals and were unimpressive in January in the finals of the African Nations' Cup when they missed out on the last eight.
